content.title: How to watch Suns vs. Lakers: TV channel and streaming options for April 10
content.text: The Phoenix Suns (44-36) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (51-29) in a matchup of Pacific Division rivals at Crypto.com Arena on April 10, 2026. This is the fifth matchup between the squads this season.How to watch Phoenix Suns vs. Los Angeles Lakers Venue: Crypto.com Arena Time: 10:30 p.m. ET TV: SportsNet LA, AZFamily, Suns+ Streaming (in-market viewers): Fubo (try for free) Streaming (out-of-market viewers): NBA League Pass Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub.
